calendarFaqs.q: When does Fort Bend ISD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fort Bend ISD starts the 2026-2027 school year on Tuesday, August 11, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fort Bend ISD Fall Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, October 12 through Friday, October 16, 2026. October 9 is a teacher planning day with no students, so families should also mark the Friday before the break.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fort Bend ISD Thanksgiving Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Thanksgiving Break runs Monday, November 23 through Friday, November 27, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fort Bend ISD Winter Break 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026 through Friday, January 1, 2027. Students return for second semester classes on Wednesday, January 6, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spring Break for Fort Bend ISD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 8 through Friday, March 12, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Fort Bend ISD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day for students is Thursday, May 27, 2027, with early release for all students.

calendarFaqs.q: How many instructional days are in Fort Bend ISD 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Fort Bend ISD 2026-2027 instructional calendar lists 172 total days of instruction and 187 total teacher contract days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Fort Bend ISD have inclement weather make-up days in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official calendar labels February 15 and April 30, 2027 as student/teacher holidays and inclement weather make-up days. Families should re-check Fort Bend ISD announcements after closures because those dates may be used to recover instructional time.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download the Fort Bend ISD 2026-2027 calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Fort Bend ISD 2026-2027 instructional calendar PDF is linked on this page from the district calendar source.

customSections.label: Calendar Details Families Should Know
customSections.content: Several dates outside the major breaks can affect pickup, childcare and family schedules. Fort Bend ISD also schedules staff days, grade-specific early-release days and two possible weather make-up days.

rows: Staff days during the school year
Sep. 25, Oct. 9, Jan. 4–5, Feb. 12 and Mar. 5
Students do not attend on these professional learning or teacher planning days.
Elementary early release
Sep. 24 and Feb. 11
These early dismissals apply to elementary students.
Middle and high school early release
Dec. 17 and May 26
These early dismissals apply to middle and high school students.
All-student early release
Dec. 18 and May 27
May 27 is also the last student day.
Early-release times
Elementary: 12:10 p.m.; middle school: 1:25 p.m.; high school: 11:35 a.m.
Possible weather make-up days
Feb. 15 and Apr. 30
Both dates are listed as student/teacher holidays but may become instructional days after closures.
Second-semester return
Jan. 6
Students return after the Jan. 4 professional learning day and Jan. 5 teacher planning day.

customSections.label: About This District Calendar
customSections.content: Fort Bend ISD's instructional calendar covers districtwide attendance dates for campuses across Sugar Land, Missouri City, Richmond and nearby Fort Bend County communities. Campus calendars remain the source for testing, athletics, performances, graduation activities and school-specific events.
